teaser: When part of the site is big enough to need its own versions: the publishers' section first, and a tree of versions from a page to the API.
core_idea: Versioning gives history to people and agents, so parts of the site that change on their own, starting with the publishers' section, should get their own version lines, each site release recording which version of each part it carries, including the API release it pins; the result is a fractal tree of versions, with the home page and article pipeline later.
